result: No unresolved blocker identified in this helper for the proposed controlled CI execution.

resolved_findings.issue: Checking elapsed time only after read(1 MiB) did not enforce a 300-second download interval.
resolved_findings.resolution: v2 installed a real-time interval timer before urlopen/read; v3 preserves it through arm_timer(300).

resolved_findings.issue: Bare raise retained ordinary exception-message output instead of the stated whitelist.
resolved_findings.resolution: v2 ordinary failure exits use SystemExit(1); v3 also catches report I/O failures in finally and exits with SystemExit(1) from None.

resolved_findings.issue: max(1,remaining) could extend the nominal total budget near its endpoint.
resolved_findings.resolution: v3 rejects exhausted remaining time and uses the positive remaining value without a one-second floor.

source_consistency.generated_files: Three files are checked by exact original bytes and SHA256; manifest is checked by all original values, because no original manifest byte hash was retained.
source_consistency.source_retention: Source DB/reader/audit stay in a fresh RUNNER_TEMP subtree; pinned extractor opens the DB read-only. Helper neither deletes nor overwrites a pre-existing private subtree.
source_consistency.public_output: Success and handled failure reports contain fixed metadata, structural counts, hashes, error class/stage and HTTP status. Child output, raw reader and source DB are not printed.

independent_refutation.result: Independently confirmed the v1 issues and v2 main repairs, and identified the finally exception-chain and remaining-time floor limits.
independent_refutation.v3_followup: This reviewer checked only the corresponding v3 changes; no additional optional refutation or broader audit was added.

limits: This is source reading, SHA computation and budget arithmetic, not Python execution, a source download, extraction, CI success, smartphone evidence, comparison readiness or an element judgment.

Unix signal handling is assumed for this helper. Report I/O runs after the process alarm is cancelled; the proposed outer 20-minute CI job is the final bound, and its workflow integration was not included in these helper blobs.
No concrete game-prose leak was observed in v1/v2; the review identified logging paths and repairs, not an incident.
Only report artifacts should be uploaded; parent-owned workflow placement, triggers and artifact selectors require their actual CI configuration.
next_action: Run the helper in the existing authorized CI and compare the pinned source and all three generated output hashes; preserve the report without publishing the private source text.
